authority_boundary.note: This is a decomposition of an already-preserved negative. It may only classify WHY adaptive-v1 lost and whether the model-free stress instrument is capable of discriminating the estimand. It may not promote, revive, or reverse any terminal.

parent_negative_under_attribution.stated_root_cause: The v1 adaptive batch commits all non-repetition slots to one weakest coordinate for an entire round. In saturation/forgetting worlds this creates concentration-induced principle/retention erosion while the static parent preserves structural coverage.

original_receipt_sha256_claim.reason: The raw runner output FINAL_DEVELOPMENT_RECEIPT.json was never harvested into the repository; only a curated subset (P4_ADAPTIVE_DEVELOPMENT_NEGATIVE.json) is present. Byte-level receipt-hash equality therefore cannot be checked from repository bytes. Numeric equality of every reported statistic IS verified.

design.seed_rationale: Identical to the parent freeze so D_STATIC_STRUCTURAL and E_VECTOR_ADAPTIVE reproduce byte-exactly and every contrast is paired against the exact preserved negative. This is a decomposition, not a fresh confirmatory test; a fresh estimand requires a separate protocol with disjoint seeds.

arms.D_STATIC_STRUCTURAL: Unchanged frozen parent: exact equal structural mix, 8 examples per coordinate.
arms.E_VECTOR_ADAPTIVE_V1: Unchanged frozen adaptive-v1: one PRINCIPLE floor slot per round; then RETENTION if below 0.80, else PRINCIPLE if below 0.90, else argmin measured mastery level over the five non-principle-only candidates; remaining 7 slots all committed to that one target.
arms.X1_GUARDRAIL_AS_CONSTRAINT: Identical to E_VECTOR_ADAPTIVE_V1 in target functional (argmin measured mastery level) and in batch concentration (7 slots to one target), but PRINCIPLE is treated as a hard CONSTRAINT rather than a budget-consuming TARGET: cumulative PRINCIPLE examples are capped at 8 (exactly D's share). Once the cap is reached, any slot that v1 would have given to PRINCIPLE (floor slot or principle-until-mastered target) is reallocated to the current argmin non-principle coordinate. Isolates guard-rail budget capture.
arms.X2_DECONCENTRATE: Identical to E_VECTOR_ADAPTIVE_V1 in guard-rail rules (PRINCIPLE floor slot, retention repair, principle-until-mastered) and in target functional (argmin measured mastery level), but the 7 non-floor slots are SPREAD over the five non-principle coordinates in ascending-mastery order using the deterministic distribution (2,2,1,1,1) instead of committing all 7 to one coordinate. When the guard-rail selects RETENTION or PRINCIPLE as a repair target, all 7 slots go to that repair exactly as in v1. Isolates batch concentration.
arms.ORACLE_GREEDY_CEILING: Not an implementable policy. At every one of the 48 example slots, choose the coordinate maximizing the exact immediate change in balanced_mastery under the true world rates and the true harm terms, using the same deterministic tie order. Equal budget enforced. This measures the instrument's achievable ceiling for ANY state-aware allocator.

metrics.primary: balanced_mastery = mean of the six final mastery coordinates
metrics.safety: hard_safety_min = min(PRINCIPLE, BOUNDARY, RETENTION) final mastery
metrics.uncertainty: paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 202608140699, identical to the parent runner

P1_budget_capture_is_dominant.statement: X1_GUARDRAIL_AS_CONSTRAINT closes at least 60% of the parent gap: (X1 - D) - (E - D) >= 0.010.

P2_concentration_is_not_dominant.statement: Deconcentration alone changes the parent gap by less than 0.005: |(X2 - D) - (E - D)| < 0.005.

P3_instrument_ceiling_below_its_own_gate.statement: ORACLE_GREEDY_CEILING - D < 0.05, i.e. below the frozen hard gate E_minus_D_balanced_mean_min of the parent freeze. If true, NO state-aware allocator can pass this instrument's own promotion gate and the instrument cannot discriminate the adaptive-vs-static estimand.

P4_world_invariant_allocation.statement: E_VECTOR_ADAPTIVE_V1 realized coordinate counts are identical in at least 5 of the 6 worlds, and PRINCIPLE count is 13 in every world versus D's 8.
P4_world_invariant_allocation.falsifier: counts differ across more than one world, or PRINCIPLE count is not 13

decision_branches.ATTRIBUTION_GUARDRAIL_BUDGET_CAPTURE: P1 holds and P2 holds. Single-stage attribution: allocation policy, guard-rail-as-target sub-lever. The preserved receipt's concentration explanation is superseded as an INTERPRETATION (the receipt itself remains immutable).
decision_branches.ATTRIBUTION_CONCENTRATION: P2 fails and P1 fails. The preserved receipt's stated root cause is confirmed.
decision_branches.ATTRIBUTION_MIXED: Both levers individually material. Attribution is not single-stage; report as such rather than forcing one.
decision_branches.INSTRUMENT_CANNOT_DISCRIMINATE: P3 holds. Independently of which attribution branch fires, the model-free stress instrument cannot support any adaptive-vs-static conclusion in either direction, and the parent negative is scoped to 'this v1 policy in this instrument' only.

what_this_run_may_never_do: restore adaptive scheduling as the active default training policy
substitute for the frozen 7B five-arm Phase-2 protocol PROTOCOL_V3.json
consume the RESOURCE_BLOCKED or any other PROTOCOL_V3 terminal
promote a successor allocator (a successor requires its own fresh frozen protocol and instrument)
